call_points.text: FY27 capex guided at ~₹6,000 Cr ±10%, split 50% growth and 50% maintenance.
16 facilities under development, 13 to come on stream in FY27, all in emerging markets.
Copper up ~38% YoY and ~16% sequentially in Q4; pass-through has a one-to-two quarter lag.
Consumer electronics capex for FY27 not firmed up; management asked for a quarter to return with numbers.

operating_notes.text: Modulos Ribera Alta SL (MRA) had FY25 turnover of Euro 92,294,953.77 and Celulosa Fabril SA (CEFA) Euro 81,595,001.28; MRA merged into CEFA on 20 April 2026.

Nissin Advanced Coating Indo (target) had FY26 turnover ₹30.4 Cr and EBITDA ₹10.3 Cr, up from ₹26.7 Cr in FY24 and ₹27.8 Cr in FY25; it makes thin film coatings and PVD coating systems, present only in India.
Vacuform 2000 Proprietary Limited, incorporated August 06, 1999, had turnover of INR 1196.25 Mn in FY2023-24, INR 1188.99 Mn in FY2024-25 and INR 1145.64 Mn in FY2025-26.
Motherson's Abu Dhabi manufacturing hub in KEZAD is being developed in phases on an approximately 87,652 sq m plot, with construction underway and more than 1,000 jobs expected.
Q4FY26 exceptional expenses of ₹194.40 Cr include ₹196.06 Cr for phased operational restructuring at units primarily in Europe and ₹31.64 Cr for labour-code gratuity and compensated absences.
FY26 gross consideration from customers before Ind AS 115 agent accounting was ₹194,009.50 Cr against reported revenue of ₹126,103.67 Cr.
The Employees Welfare Trust held 23,211,370 treasury shares at Mar-2026, and 23,211,370 ESOPs were granted on May 4, 2026.
Book business of USD 96 billion at FY26, with 22% from EV programs and ~3% non-automotive; EV share of revenue is around 11%.
Aerospace order book at USD 1.6 billion, typically executed over 5-8 years; aerospace revenue grew 40% YoY in FY26.
Consumer electronics revenue grew ~7.5x YoY in FY26; GF1 and GF2 reached 14-16 million unit annualised run rate in Q4FY26.
Commissioned first 15 MWp ground-mounted captive solar power project in Mahoba, Uttar Pradesh, via Onega Solar Private Limited.
Copper prices rose 4% sequentially and 40% YoY in Q1FY27, after 13% and 16% sequential rises in Q3FY26 and Q4FY26.
Polymer prices in Germany rose 55% YoY and 66% sequentially, and the World Container Index rose 40% YoY and 83% sequentially.
Consumer electronics third plant capacity is 40 million units annually at full scale; the two existing plants were described as prototypes with small batch production.
Dissolution of inactive indirect subsidiary Yachiyo of Ontario MFG., Inc., Canada, effective October 14, 2026.

timeline.summary: On 21 April 2026, Samvardhana Motherson said Spain's Commercial Register of Zaragoza completed the merger of indirect subsidiary Modulos Ribera Alta SL into its holding company Celulosa Fabril SA on 20 April 2026, with MRA ceasing to exist from 14 April 2026.
Vivek Chaand Sehgal, Promoter, confirmed no share encumbrance by Samvardhana Motherson Group members during FY2025-26 as of March 31, 2026.

On 27 April 2026, Samvardhana Motherson's board approved buying Nissin Electric Japan's 51% of Nissin Advanced Coating Indo for ₹9.23 Cr cash, taking the JV to 100% ownership via SAMIL (51%) and SMISL (49%), with closing expected by end-Q1FY27.
Samvardhana Motherson approved acquiring the remaining 49% stake in Vacuform 2000 for ₹25.3 Cr.

On 6 May 2026, the Abu Dhabi Investment Office announced support for Motherson's phased automotive components manufacturing hub in KEZAD, Abu Dhabi, on an ~87,652 sq m plot with construction underway.

Samvardhana Motherson International Limited schedules earnings conference call on audited Q4 FY26 results for May 20, 2026, at 1700 hrs IST with **Mr Vivek Chaand Sehgal**, **Mr Laksh Vaaman Sehgal**, **Mr Pankaj Mital**, **Mr Gandharv Tongia**, and **Mr Rajat Jain** participating.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹34,309.31 Cr (+17.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,497.14 Cr (+42.5% YoY).

On 20 May 2026, Samvardhana Motherson's board gave in-principle approval to issue rated, listed, unsecured, redeemable NCDs of face value ₹1,00,000 each for up to ₹5,000 Cr on a private placement basis.
On May 20, 2026, Samvardhana Motherson approved the appointment of B S R & Co. LLP as statutory auditor for a five-year term starting from the 40th AGM.
Samvardhana Motherson announced the completion of the merger of SMR Auto-Japan into Misato Industries, both indirect wholly owned subsidiaries.

On 20 May 2026, Samvardhana Motherson's Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 capex at ~₹6,000 Cr ±10%, flagged 13 of 16 new facilities starting in FY27 and consumer electronics GF3 commissioning in Q3FY27, with leverage at an all-time low of 0.8x.
On June 8, 2026, Samvardhana Motherson announced the commissioning of its first 15 MWp captive solar power project in Mahoba, Uttar Pradesh, via its subsidiary Onega Solar Private Limited and MNEL.

Q1FY27 call (Aug 6, 2026): highest-ever quarterly revenue, up 17% YoY, EBITDA margin up 60 bps, leverage at an all-time low 0.8x; consumer electronics third plant on track for Q3FY27 with total capex of about ₹7,500 Cr.
2026-10-14: Motherson's indirect US subsidiary MSID USA received a USD 19,500 (≈₹18.67 lakh) New York workers' compensation penalty notice; it will appeal, citing no New York employees in the period.
Motherson's inactive indirect Canadian subsidiary Yachiyo Canada was dissolved effectively on October 14, 2026.
